name: AUSTIN
source: NGX (doclib.ngxgroup.com) | CRON 20261025: rebuilt from the audited financial statements of Austin Laz and Company Plc for the year ended 31 December 2025, statement of profit or loss and other comprehensive income, printed in thousands of naira and stored here in absolute naira. FY2025: Revenue, Cost of Sales and Gross Profit are printed as dashes, meaning NIL, because the company recorded no trading in the year; the only charge is Administration Expenses 16,237, so Profit before Tax is -16,237. The Revenue and Cost of Sales previously stored in the FY2025 column (1,316,125 and 1,316,450) were the prior year figures shifted one column forward and have been replaced. FY2024, as restated in the same audited statement: Revenue 1,316,125, Cost of Sales 1,159,845, Gross Profit 156,280, Other Income 6,174, Distribution Expenses 28,582 and Administration Expenses 128,069, which sums to the printed Profit before Tax of 5,803; tax 1,571 gives Profit after Tax 4,232 and earnings per share of 0.00 naira, all as printed. Finance Cost is printed as a dash in both years, so Net Finance Costs is stored as nil rather than left blank. Units: Nigerian naira, absolute.
